ResearchTabDef.label: Robotics
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Build robot stations and assemble autonomous household robots.

ResearchProjectDef.label: domestic robotics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a nanny robot station. The station assembles a domestic robot that sweeps, scrubs and hauls without needing food or sleep, and recharges from the colony power grid.

ResearchProjectDef.label: robotic mechanical body
ResearchProjectDef.description: Load-bearing chassis, joints, armor mounts and maintenance access for a self-maintaining domestic android.

ResearchProjectDef.label: robotic actuation system
ResearchProjectDef.description: High-torque actuators and closed-loop limb control for precise household manipulation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: robotic perception system
ResearchProjectDef.description: Stereo optical sensors, proximity arrays and spatial mapping for safe movement around furniture and colonists.

ResearchProjectDef.label: AI compute platform
ResearchProjectDef.description: A compact inference core that schedules chores, handles interruptions and keeps the android stable over long deployments.

ResearchProjectDef.label: dexterous robotic hand
ResearchProjectDef.description: Multi-finger hands with force feedback for cooking, cleaning and handling delicate household objects.

ResearchProjectDef.label: battery and energy system
ResearchProjectDef.description: High-density cells, thermal control and self-diagnostic charging hardware for a long-endurance android.

ResearchProjectDef.label: robotic software system
ResearchProjectDef.description: Layered control software, fail-safe routines and self-maintenance diagnostics for the Mk-V platform.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mk-V self-maintaining android
ResearchProjectDef.description: Integrate the mechanical body, actuation, perception, AI compute, dexterous hands, power system and software into the final self-maintaining nanny android.
